tool-call.instructions: Tool call {id} ({tool}) {input}: should it stay in the compacted history? Knowing this call was made, with its input, still matters for what the assistant does next.

tool-result.instructions: The {resultChars}-char output of tool call {id} ({tool}): keep it verbatim, summarize it, or drop it? Re-running the tool can recover it; weigh the cost of losing the contents against the tokens it occupies.

assistant-text.instructions: This assistant message: keep it verbatim or summarize it? Weigh whether its exact wording still matters for what the assistant does next.

thinking.instructions: This assistant thinking block: summarize or drop it? Keep (as a summary) only what formed something durable — plans, decisions, findings — not ephemeral reasoning.
